review_findings.finding: Nested database pool use inside rollback transactions could exhaust the20-connection process pool.
review_findings.resolution: Historical lookup/candidate methods now use the held SqlClient.

review_findings.finding: Generic rollback could otherwise lift a newly imposed security quarantine.
review_findings.resolution: Reject rollback if security-rule snapshot differs; require dedicated incident/remediation proposal.

review_findings.finding: Rejected foundation changes would lose audit if logged in the aborted transaction.
review_findings.resolution: Persist only sanitized operation/error code in a separate post-rollback audit, preserving original error on audit failure.

review_findings.finding: Package lock alone cannot enforce all platform workers, servicing operations, recipient properties or true resource-derived scope.
review_findings.resolution: Root must integrate guarded transactions and safe-money exception handling; full leaf remains in_progress.

review_findings.finding: An active quarantine could have been moved to a narrower scope or future start while still enabled, silently releasing existing coverage without recovery evidence.
review_findings.resolution: Existing active quarantine keeps incident, scope, effectiveFrom, dependencies, rollout and regional evidence until an explicit remediation-backed disable is independently approved; added three regression substitutions.

review_findings.finding: Existing approved credit must be reclassified into installments once instead of creating a second receivable/provider liability
Installment receipt targets the owned stable planId, not an external agreement alias
Stored externally paid evidence must never be downgraded to rejected and release held funds

Root blocks wallet refund HTTP execution with refund_approval_not_configured and removes the ordinary seed grant; internal provenance method remains tested but is not a complete dual-control refund workflow.
review_findings.next_action: Implement owner refund request plus independently authorized approval consumed once under the order lock before enabling execution.

review_findings.finding: All three pure finance suites now use independently generated st_finance_fixture_<uuid> databases: invariant tests apply ordered platform/business SQL, ports and servicing apply ordered platform/finance SQL. Each suite closes its pool and drops only its created fixture. No search_path fallback, public mock payout rows, public order/journal writes or shared demo control injection remains in those suites.
review_findings.historical_scope: Existing synthetic rows from previous suite runs were not deleted or repaired; append-only public ledger history was preserved.

review_findings.finding: Recovery now separates exact snapshot match from scoped business consistency. Every committed order must have exactly one canonical purchase event and a matching carrier submission with tenant, owner, product, carrier and commitment kind consistent; wallet v2 requires a wallet reference without invented cash receipt fields. Historical inconsistent synthetic sources are captured but cannot receive verified=true.
review_findings.next_action: Record the current local drill result under the stronger gate; label historical synthetic anomalies without deleting append-only ledger history. A clean source and all other production gates remain required before release.
